en.headline: Five vehicles collide near Cheung Tsing Tunnel exit, three injured
en.dek: Police received a report at about 6.44pm of a multi-vehicle crash involving a light goods vehicle and private cars on the Kowloon-bound side; three people with minor injuries were taken to hospital and some lanes were…
body: Police said they received a report at about 6.44pm on Monday of a collision involving five vehicles near the Kowloon-bound exit of the Cheung Tsing Tunnel on Tsing Kwai Highway.

The vehicles included a light goods vehicle and private cars. Emergency services attended the scene. Three people were confirmed injured; all were conscious with minor injuries and were taken by ambulance to Princess Margaret Hospital.

The Transport Department said parts of the Kowloon-bound lanes near the tunnel exit were closed because of the crash, with motorists advised to consider alternative routes as traffic became busy. Some lanes were later reopened after clearance work.
The cause of the collision is under investigation.

zh.headline: 長青隧道出口附近5車相撞 3人輕傷
zh.dek: 警方晚上約6時44分接報青葵公路往九龍方向長青隧道出口附近多車相撞，涉及輕型貨車及私家車；3名傷者清醒輕傷，部分行車線一度封閉。
body: 警方表示，周一晚上約6時44分接獲報案，指青葵公路往九龍方向近長青隧道出口發生5車相撞意外，涉及輕型貨車及私家車等。
救援人員到場，證實有3名傷者，全部清醒並只受輕傷，已由救護車送往瑪嘉烈醫院治理。
運輸署表示，因交通意外，青葵公路往九龍方向近長青隧道出口的部分行車線一度封閉，駕駛人士只可使用餘下行車線，並呼籲考慮改用其他道路。清理後部分行車線已解封，現場交通曾繁忙。
